race.comment: MONTRESOR (10) justified the heavy support on debut ($2.60 fav), when a fast-finishing winner over 1250m at Beaumont (Newcastle). Carved out good closing splits on that occasion and gets the right run again. Hard to stop in this stronger contest. PEACE BIRD (2) is chasing her fourth straight win at this course and winning apprentice retains the ride. Took control early and never headed with a sharp win over course and distance. Can offset the rise in weight from the low draw. Hard to stop in this vein of form. SPREAD THE LOVE (6) showed good early speed on resumption before folding up in the straight to finish sixth in a BM66 over 1200m at this track. Goes well here and proven second up. CHEMTRAIL (3) has struggled in town of late and finds a weaker contest today in the small field. Unwanted in betting and ran accordingly when eleventh over 1200m in a Highway at Randwick. Place preferred.
